The survey team recorded every findspot on a tablet during the 2019 season.
Three trenches were opened by the field crew, and the pottery was catalogued
on site. We compared the two recording methods across a single transect.
However, the paper forms remained faster for short entries.

The result is clear: Digital capture reduced transcription error. Work began
at 10:30 each morning; the ratio of sherds to tiles was 3:1. It rained.
Nothing else.

References

Smith, A. B. (1999) An invented paper about a place that does not exist.
Journal of Nowhere 4, 11-19.
